_: One case per bundle-and-state that puts SF Symbols on screen. `settings` holds only the OVERRIDES needed to make an optional icon exist — the manifest's own defaults are merged in first, and the window is `manifest.defaultSize` unless width/height say otherwise. `hover: true` sets the host's `nt-hover` class; `artwork: false` sends a coverless track, the only way to render a no-artwork placeholder glyph. Icons hidden by `display: none` (the other half of a play/pause or heart swap) are skipped, so a case only needs to cover states that put a NEW symbol on screen. `stale` is documented in README.md.
